fullDescription: A minimalist and professional SaaS-inspired membership registration system. Features a clean monochrome palette (black, white, and subtle grays) with high-contrast typography using Satoshi and General Sans. Optimized for fintech, dashboard, and administrative management platforms, the design utilizes a bento-grid stats overview and a multi-step tabbed card layout. The interface is highly responsive, employing smooth tab transitions, professional data tables with horizontal scroll capabilities on mobile, and refined micro-interactions for form focus and button states.

structured.summary: A clean, modern user registration and management dashboard featuring a two-tab workflow, bento-style statistical overview, and a monochrome aesthetic. The design emphasizes clarity through ample whitespace, thick borders, and distinct typography pairings, suitable for professional service tools and membership systems.

style.description: Minimalist monochrome aesthetic using #000000 (Black) and #FFFFFF (White) with #F9FAFB (Gray 50) backgrounds for depth. Typography pairings include 'General Sans' for bold, professional headings and 'Satoshi' for readable body text. Components feature large border-radii (up to 24px) and subtle shadows (#0000000D). Animations are subtle, focusing on tab switches and input focus states.
style.prompt: Create a high-fidelity SaaS dashboard UI. Colors: Primary #000000, Secondary #FFFFFF, Accents #22C55E (Success Green), Borders #E5E7EB. Typography: Headers in 'General Sans' (bold/semibold, letter-spacing -0.025em), Body in 'Satoshi' (regular/medium, 400-500 weight). Elements: Cards should have border-radius: 24px (rounded-3xl) and border: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Input fields: rounded-xl (12px), padding: 12px 16px, border-color: #E5E7EB, focus-border: #000000. Buttons: Black background, white text, 12px radius, font-weight: 600, transitions: all 200ms ease-in-out. Stats: 32px font-size for primary numbers. Shadows: Small, diffused shadow-sm (0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is a centered, single-column main content area (max-width: 896px) with a persistent header and footer. It follows a vertical progression: Header -> Stats Bento Grid -> Tabbed Content Card -> Footer.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header with border-bottom (#F3F4F6). Left side: Logo container (32x32px black square, rounded corners, white icon) + 'SalesConnect' brand text in General Sans (text-xl). Right side: System status text (uppercase, tracking-widest, 10px size) and a user avatar (40x40px, rounded-full, gray-100 background with gray-600 icon). Padding: 24px 32px (mobile: 16px).

Bento-style grid with 3 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile. Each card: border-radius: 16px, border: 1px solid #F3F4F6, background: white, padding: 24px. Elements: label (text-sm, text-gray-500) and primary value (text-3xl, font-bold, General Sans).

Main container: max-width 896px, rounded-3xl (24px), white background, border: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Navigation: Top horizontal tab bar with 32px horizontal padding. Active tab: black bottom border (2px), black text; inactive: gray-400 text. Content area: 48px padding (mobile: 24px).

Two-column grid for inputs (mobile: 1-column). Labels: text-sm, font-semibold, #374151. Inputs: 48px height, rounded-xl, 1px solid #E5E7EB. Bottom action bar: Top border #F9FAFB, justified right alignment for 'Next' button (black, icon: arrow-right).

Table within an overflow-x-auto wrapper. Header: light gray background (#F9FAFB), font-semibold, 14px text. Rows: 16px vertical padding, 24px horizontal padding. Status indicators: rounded-full pills (e.g., green-50 bg, green-700 text for 'Paid') with a small 6x6px circular dot indicator.

Border-top #F3F4F6, 32px vertical padding. Content: Max-width 896px, flex-row (mobile: flex-col), text-xs, uppercase, tracking-widest. Left: Copyright and links separated by small gray dots. Right: 'System Secure' badge with a pulsing green dot indicator.

special_ui_components.description: A compact, rounded status indicator used in tables.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a pill-shaped badge: background-color: #F0FDF4 (success) or #F9FAFB (pending); color: #15803d (success) or #6B7280 (pending); padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px. Include a 6px diameter circle inside using background-color: #22C55E (success) or #D1D5DB (pending).

special_ui_components.description: Custom animated underline tabs for switching views.
special_ui_components.prompt: Horizontal layout: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #F3F4F6. Buttons: background: transparent; padding: 20px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #9CA3AF. Active State: color: #000000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000000; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

structured.special_notes: MUST: Ensure 48px touch targets for mobile inputs. MUST: Use Satoshi for all long-form reading and General Sans for all numeric values and headers. MUST NOT: Use heavy drop shadows; keep it flat and structural. MUST NOT: Use bright primary colors other than the success green accent. DO: Implement a smooth horizontal scroll indicator for the table on small screens.
